subject: Change of Billing Ledger & PO Assignment for Renewal - Action Required
messages:
From: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@stratify.com>, Finance Ops <ap-finance@stratify.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Nov 2028 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Renewal billing: proposed ledger split and PO assignment

Hi Lena —

As we finalize the Q4 renewal and the added Dedicated capacity (+150k tokens/month), Stratifys procurement asked us to confirm invoice routing. Stratify intends to split the commitment between two internal ledgers; they asked that invoices reflect the ledger codes so their AP team can reconcile to separate cost centers.

Proposed approach from our side: Redwood issues a primary invoice to Stratify, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789) and we include a ledger line item mapping (LGR-RED-01 = product, LGR-RED-02 = support). Stratify will attach a single PO that references both ledger codes and a payor contact.

Can you confirm that:
- Stratify will accept a single consolidated invoice with ledger lines (we will include the mapping on the invoice PDF)
- The PO should be addressed to "Redwood, Inc." (legal entity) and sent to billing@redwood.com
- Net terms: is Net60 still fine for the expanded commitment?

I attached our latest W9 and a draft commitment sheet for reference. If you'd rather issue two POs (one per ledger), let me know and we'll split the invoice accordingly.

Next steps: once you confirm the PO target and terms I will loop in Ben (Finance) to provide final invoice instructions and EIN validation.

Thanks —
Jasmine Liu
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jasmine_liu@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_w9_signed.pdf (pdf), commitment_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@stratify.com>
To: Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Finance Ops <ap-finance@stratify.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 10:04:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: Renewal billing: proposed ledger split and PO assignment

Jasmine —

Thanks for the clarity. A couple quick items from AP:

1) We can accept a single consolidated invoice as long as each ledger line has the code and a short description. That will work with our ERP reconciliation.
2) PO should be generated to the vendor name matching your W9. Please confirm the exact legal name on the W9 we should reference for the PO.
3) Net60 is acceptable for this renewal.

We will need an explicit payor contact (name + email) that our AP team can use for payment questions and remittance. Also, please confirm the invoicing email address (billing@redwood.com) is monitored by finance ops for PO matching.

I'll generate a PO number once we get the legal payor name and IT/Finance confirmation.

Best,
Lena Ortiz
Director, Finance Operations | Stratify, Inc.
lena.ortiz@stratify.com
Attachments: stratify_req_form.pdf (pdf)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@stratify.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 16 Nov 2028 13:22:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal billing: proposed ledger split and PO assignment

Hi Lena — looping in Ben from Finance to confirm ledger mapping and legal name details.

To confirm internally: the correct legal payor name for the W9 you received is "Redwood, Inc." (EIN 12-3456789). Billing should be sent to billing@redwood.com and that mailbox is monitored by our AP team.

Proposed invoice layout (example):
- Line 1: Dedicated capacity — LGR-RED-01 — $45,000
- Line 2: Support/Onboarding — LGR-RED-02 — $12,500
- Summary: Total due $57,500 (Net60)

If you prefer two separate POs we can accept that, but consolidated with ledger lines is our preference to reduce processing.

Jasmine — please confirm if Stratify needs a separate legal payor for part of the commitment (I know you mentioned two ledgers but not two entities). If so, we'll need a PO per entity.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Manager
marissa_cole@redwood.com
Attachments: commitment_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@stratify.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Jasmine Liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 17 Nov 2028 08:47:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal billing: proposed ledger split and PO assignment

Thanks for the details. Two operational items from Finance before we finalize:

1) Please confirm the payor entity name to match tax/EIN records. On the W9 we have "Redwood, Inc." as payee; Stratify's PO should reference that exact string for automatic matching.
2) For split-payor scenarios we require a signed allocation confirmation (email is fine) indicating percentage or dollar split per entity/ledger so our AR team can apply payments correctly.

I attached the commitment sheet with a proposed invoice sample and a small note on invoice metadata (PO number must be in the invoice header). If Stratify will issue a single PO that references both ledger codes we are happy to accept it — just include the mapping in the PO comment.

Ben Carter
Finance Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.com
Attachments: commitment_sheet.xlsx (xlsx)
